purpose: natural temporal deployment shift without engineered tilting
dataset: UCI Gas Turbine CO and NOx Emission Data Set
source_protocol: UCI-recommended first three years train/CV and last two years test
note: Target-Cal-SCP-Reference uses target labels only as a non-deployable diagnostic; all practical correction methods are label-free on target. Natural temporal layer may contain conditional as well as covariate drift and is not treated as an exact covariate-shift experiment.
